hero.title: Sell your product. Or earn from home.
hero.lede: The merchant lists the product. The marketer sells it from home, from their link. Profit is split in an open ledger both sides can see.

problem.title: Why most businesses lose money with marketing agencies
problem.lede: The same pattern shows up no matter the agency size. The fix starts with seeing it clearly.

items.title: Slow bureaucracy
items.text: You talk to an account manager. They talk to a delivery team. A small change takes days.

items.title: A new person on your account
items.text: The person who sold the contract is not the person running the campaign.

items.title: Reports that do not mean much
items.text: Reach and impressions, with no clear link to actual sales.

items.title: No stake in the result
items.text: You pay the same fee whether the campaign works or fails.

problem.vizCauseYou: Your change never reaches the doer
problem.vizRelayAria: How a small change travels through three people
problem.vizHint: Select a step to see where time is lost

roadmap.title: Pick a role. Take the next step.
roadmap.lede: Five clear steps. Tap a step to read what happens next.

merchantSteps.title: Register the company
merchantSteps.text: Two minutes. You pick the merchant role, fill registry details, then enter your portal.

merchantSteps.title: Add the product and commission
merchantSteps.text: Photo, price, sizes if needed, and the marketer share. It appears in the catalog at once.

merchantSteps.title: A marketer adds it to their store
merchantSteps.text: Creators pick from your catalog. No one-off WhatsApp threads.

merchantSteps.title: You confirm the order
merchantSteps.text: Every COD order lands on your dashboard. Approve or reject. Same status the admin sees.

merchantSteps.title: Profit in an open ledger
merchantSteps.text: Merchant share, commission, and platform fee. The number shows at the order, not in a month-end report.

creatorSteps.title: Register and open your store
creatorSteps.text: Pick the marketer role. The storefront is ready at signup. One link with your name.

creatorSteps.title: Pick merchant products
creatorSteps.text: The feed shows trending products as posts. Pick one, apply, and see commission before you share.

creatorSteps.title: Share the link
creatorSteps.text: Story, reel, or bio. Every tap on your link is yours. No guessing who closed the sale.

creatorSteps.title: The order is counted for you
creatorSteps.text: The customer pays cash on delivery from your store. The order shows for the merchant and for you.

creatorSteps.title: Your commission in the ledger
creatorSteps.text: Your share is calculated automatically. You see it on the dashboard, with the same numbers the merchant sees.

ledger.title: The profit waterfall, line by line. No net figure hiding the detail.
ledger.lede: The same deduction order you see on your dashboard: from the sale to each party's share. Tap a line to see why it is deducted, and what remains after it.
ledger.disclaimer: An illustrative preview with sample numbers, not real sales or customer data.
ledger.hint: Tap a line. The large number follows you.
ledger.splitCaption: How the profit pool splits across the three parties
ledger.whyGmv: Every rial is attributed to a specific creator link. This is the starting figure, not the profit.
ledger.whyReturns: 8% is held for returns before any split. The cost shows here, not after it vanishes into a report.
ledger.whyNet: After the reserve. The creator's guaranteed floor is calculated from this line.
ledger.whyFees: Payment-gateway fees. A real deal cost, not an agency commission.
ledger.whyCogs: Product cost comes out before any share. No paper profit on top of the goods.
ledger.whyAds: Ad spend recorded on the deal. Every rial to Meta appears in the same ledger.
ledger.whyPool: What remains after real costs. This is what splits between creator, merchant, and platform.
ledger.creatorFloorDetail: The creator floor was paid: a guaranteed minimum of net attributed sales, regardless of ads.
ledger.creatorPoolDetail: The creator share was paid from the profit pool (28%), above the guaranteed floor.
ledger.merchantDetail: What remains of the pool after the creator share. The merchant's cut of actual profit.
ledger.platformDetail: Growlab's share. Paid only when there is a real profit pool.

valueChain.title: Publish the product. Marketers join. The kit and the link move with them.
valueChain.lede: The merchant lists the product in every marketer's feed. After the merchant accepts an application, the full product kit lands in the marketer's store, with a trackable referral link. Selling and profit start there.

nodes.title: The feed
nodes.desc: Trending products show as posts: media, name, sale price, and marketer commission. Pick a product and apply from one place.

nodes.title: Apply
nodes.desc: The marketer joins the campaign in one tap. No hunting merchants on WhatsApp, and no one-off terms.

nodes.title: Merchant accept
nodes.desc: The merchant accepts the right marketer. The product enters no store until that accept. Control stays with the merchant.

nodes.title: Kit transfer
nodes.desc: This is the move: on accept, every product detail copies into the marketer's store, and a trackable referral link appears. Ready to share on day one, without re-uploading photos or pasting a brief.

nodes.title: Sell and earn
nodes.desc: The marketer shares the link with friends and on social. Every sale from that link is attributed in the ledger. Profit comes from sales.

partners.title: Real advantages for whoever supplies the product or the content
partners.lede: We are not selling you a vague promise. This is the mechanism every deal on the platform actually runs on.

items.title: Precise sales attribution
items.text: Every order is tied to a specific creator link or code, inside a fixed attribution window. No guessing who closed the sale.

items.title: Real ad accounting
items.text: Every rial that goes to Meta is recorded as a cost line in your deal, measured against actual sales. No hidden line inside an agency report.

items.title: A clear payout clock
items.text: A short hold window protects both sides from returns and fraud. After that, your share is available to withdraw. No stalling and no opaque calendar.

governance.title: Protection is built into the system, not into a promise
governance.lede: Six fixed rules govern every deal on the platform. They are not an exception we grant if you ask.

items.title: Creator floor
items.text: A guaranteed minimum: a share of your net attributed sales after the reserve and before any ad decision. Weak ad spend cannot zero it out.

items.title: A locked deal snapshot
items.text: Price and commission lock at the moment of agreement. A discount added later cannot cut your share retroactively.

items.title: A hold window for protection
items.text: Part of the share is held for a short period after the order. Protection from returns and fraud, not delay in payout.

items.title: A transparent ledger per order
items.text: Each order is its own line: sale, reserve, fees, product cost, ads, and each party's share. No blended net figure where the detail disappears.

items.title: No direct contact between parties
items.text: Merchant and creator never exchange phone numbers or off-platform accounts. Filters block leaks in any form. Sample and shipping requests are coordinated entirely inside Growlab.

items.title: Exclusive tracking protects your commission
items.text: Your commission is guaranteed only through your referral link and personal store inside Growlab. Leaving the platform is a financial risk for the creator, and a loss of sale integrity for the merchant.

pricing.title: How we split profit. No subscription. No fees.
pricing.lede: Every sale is calculated automatically: returns reserve, payment fees, product cost and ads. Then the remaining pool is split between creator, merchant, and platform. No number is up for private negotiation.
pricing.merchantSubtitle: You keep full control of your product and your commission rate
pricing.merchantStatNote: of the remaining pool after costs goes to the merchant

founders.title: One founder. Built as a market, not a service.
founders.name: Qusay Nader Al-Nabarawi
founders.p1: I am Qusay, a cybersecurity student first. The first question I ask about any system is: "Where is the gap?" I built Growlab on that question, not on a ready marketing slogan.
founders.p2: A platform that handles commissions and money for merchants and creators has to be hardened against fraud by design, not after a breach. That is what actually protects your money, and every partner's money on the platform, not just on paper.
founders.p3: On the other side, five years spent in real marketing. Real campaigns, real budgets, real clients. I am not building a theoretical security system only an engineer understands. I am building it for a market where every merchant and creator has to sell from day one.
founders.quote: We only earn if you earn. That is the whole difference.
